title: Senior Azure Cloud Solution Architect
description:
Senior Azure Cloud Solution Architect

Location: Brazil / Argentina (Remote)

Long term contract

Overview

We are seeking a visionary Automation Senior Cloud Solution Architect to lead the technical design and implementation of this transformative capability. This role is pivotal in architecting a scalable, AI-driven solution that seamlessly integrates advanced data processing, intuitive web interfaces, and intelligent automation.

This position demands a strategic leader who thrives in complexity and is deeply committed to cultivating strong stakeholder relationships. You will play a key role in fostering a culture of innovation and collaboration, guiding cross-functional teams to deliver solutions that drive pricing transparency, operational efficiency, and market competitiveness.

The ideal candidate will bring a unique blend of technical depth and strategic foresight, with a proven track record of leveraging cutting-edge technologies to deliver end-to-end automation at scale. The role will interface with Enterprise Architecture, Business leaders, Senior Leaders and Cyber / Privacy / Legal teams.

Responsibilities

  • Champion Software Excellence & Talent Development. Promote strong SDLC practices including clean architecture, automated testing, and scalable design. Mentor junior developers through code reviews, technical guidance, and collaborative learning to foster a high-performing engineering culture.
  • Lead Automation use cases architecture using technologies like GenAI, API, D&A, etc, working closely with Product Managers, automation engineers and stakeholders across business and DTS, and Enterprise Architecture.
  • End-to-End Platform Development. Build and maintain front-end (React, TypeScript, Next.js) and back-end (Python, FastAPI, Node.js) layers that support GenAI workflows and agentic interactions.
  • API & Agent Framework Integration. Design robust REST and GraphQL APIs for real-time agent communication, tool execution, and memory handling. Integrate frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, and vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma, Weaviate).
  • ETL & Data Pipeline Architecture. Architect and optimize ETL pipelines for real-time and batch data processing. Ensure seamless data flow between GenAI services, databases, and user interfaces.
  • Cloud-Native Deployment & Monitoring. Deploy and scale services using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI / CD pipelines. Apply MLOps best practices for monitoring, versioning, and performance tuning of AI components.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration. Work closely with AI researchers, product managers, and delivery teams to align technical execution with strategic goals. Participate in multi-agent orchestration experiments and rapid prototyping cycles.

Key Qualifications and Experiences

Technical Expertise :

  • Cloud Platform Proficiency: Solid experience (minimum 5 years) in architecting, deploying, and managing applications across leading cloud platforms, demonstrating comprehensive knowledge of cloud services including computing, database management, application development, and integration services. Familiarity with cloud-native services (Azure), containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes), and serverless architectures is highly valued.
  • Embedded Systems and CI / CD: Experience with embedded devices, operating systems, and server-client architecture. Proficient in CI / CD and DevSecOps practices.
  • Architecture Design: Experience in Microservices and Event-Driven Architecture. Understanding architecture design principles and patterns. Experience with SQL Server, Web Services (SOAP / REST) and API development.
  • NET Development Skills: Extensive hands-on experience in building scalable, high-performance applications using .NET technologies, with strong capabilities in C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET, and Entity Framework. Knowledge of web technologies and frameworks, such as Blazor or ASP.NET MVC, is also crucial.
  • Integration with SAP and Salesforce: Demonstrated ability to integrate .NET applications with both SAP and Salesforce platforms, employing APIs and middleware solutions like SAP Process Orchestration or API to facilitate robust data exchange and streamline workflows across these systems.
  • Security and Compliance: Deep understanding of security practices related to cloud-hosted applications, including implementing secure authentication and authorization mechanisms (e.g., OAuth, OpenID Connect) and ensuring compliance with relevant industry security standards.
  • Scalability and High Availability: Proven expertise in designing applications that are highly scalable and resilient, leveraging cloud scalability features such as load balancing, auto-scaling, and caching services to ensure optimal performance and availability.
  • Agile Development Practices: Strong background in Agile methodologies, adept at managing product backlogs, user stories, sprint planning, and releases, particularly within a cloud-hosted application development environment.
  • Strategic Problem Solving and Analytical Thinking: Ability to address complex technical and integration challenges with a strategic mindset, utilizing analytical and data-driven decision-making to optimize the application's performance and capabilities.

Specialized Skills :

  • Prototyping: Ability to engage in rapid prototype development using iterative techniques.
  • Vendor and Partner Engagement: Direct experience managing relationships with outsourcing and consulting partners.
  • Cloud Architecture Design: Deep understanding of cloud solutions and architectures, enabling scalable, flexible, and resilient digital infrastructures that support rapid innovation and development.

Soft Skills and Others :

  • Agile Collaboration: Demonstrated experience in effectively working with Agile and Product teams, including involvement with epics, user stories, sprints, and backlog management. The ability to collaborate closely with product owners, engineers, and scrum master’s to foster a productive and agile environment.
  • Leadership in Communication and Reporting: Skilled in leading communication efforts and reporting, adept at preparing and presenting comprehensive updates and reports to senior leaders and stakeholders. Ability to succinctly highlight key metrics, progress, and insights, ensuring transparency and alignment at all levels of the organization.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Background in coordinating hardware & software development teams and business owners, with the ability to influence SMEs directly.

title: Strategic Partnership & Alliance
description:
About RateGain

RateGain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered SaaS solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. RateGain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.

Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today RateGain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.

Exploring the role

RateGain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, RateGain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.

The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.

This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.

Job responsibilities

  • Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
  • Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with RateGain’s GTM strategy in LATAM
  • Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
  • Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
  • Represent RateGain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
  • Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
  • Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trends

Education & Work Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnerships

Knowledge

  • In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem
  • Knowledge of SaaS business models and partnership structures
  • Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectors

Skills

  • Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
  • Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills in Spanish, Portuguese, and English
  • Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
  • Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
  • Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)

Attitude

  • Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
  • Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team
  • High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership
  • Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

title: Açougueiro - Comendador Soares
description:
Descrição Do Trabalho

Atender ao cliente conforme solicitação, observando as normas relativas à fiscalização sanitária e relativas à medicina ocupacional do trabalho, dentre as estabelecidas na presente instrução.

  • Atender os clientes com atenção, educação, cordialidade e presteza.
  • Selecionar o corte escolhido pelo cliente atenendo às especificações de marca, quantidade e qualidade do produto.
  • Servir o cliente conforme solicitação, seguindo os padrões de corte conhecidos no mercado, buscando a plena satisfação do cliente e observando o método de trabalho da empresa.
  • Manter o balcão de carnes limpo, higienizado, organizado, arrumado e cheio de produto.
  • Preparar as receitas conforme manual.
  • Manter a câmara frigorífica limpa, higienizada e arrumada, assegurando a retirada de mercadorias vencidas.
  • Manter o estoque arrumado e com as validades mais antigas saindo primeiro.
  • Informar ao encarregado direto qualquer problema com produtos do setor e/ou com clientes insatisfeitos.
  • Verificar diariamente a validade de todos os produtos que fazem parte da seção, retirando imediatamente os que se encontram para vencer no prazo de 30 dias e informando ao superior as condições do produto.
  • Solicitar autorização ao superior hierárquico para desprezar produtos que se encontram fora da validade e/ou que estejam em condições inadequadas ao consumo, retirando-os da área de venda e armazenagem imediatamente de forma devida e orientada.
  • Usar EPI, especialmente na câmara fria, para organização e arrumação, obrigatoriamente a luva de malha de aço para fins de corte de carne, sendo proibido o exercício da atribuição sem o equipamento necessário.
  • Permanecer apenas o tempo necessário em ambientes prejudiciais à saúde, condicionada ao uso do equipamento individual indicado pelo serviço de medicina ocupacional, sendo terminantemente proibido o ingresso nas câmaras frias sem o equipamento de proteção individual necessário.
  • Zelar pela apresentação pessoal e utilizar uniforme limpo e conservado.
  • Manter as botas e o avental limpos e higienizados.
  • Usar cabelo e unhas cortados.
  • A utilização de touca é obrigatória no setor e faz parte do uniforme.
  • Utilizar máscara protetora.
  • É proibido o uso de barba e bigode por questões de fiscalização sanitária.
  • É proibido o uso de acessórios (brincos, pulseiras, relógios e outros) por questões de segurança do trabalho, pois podem ocasionar acidentes.
  • É obrigatório o uso de luvas descartáveis para manipulação dos produtos e para atendimento ao cliente.

Huron helps its clients drive growth, enhance performance and sustain leadership in the markets they serve. To succeed long-term, healthcare organizations must empower leaders, clinicians, employees, affiliates and communities to build cultures that foster innovation to achieve the best outcomes for patients.

Joining the Huron team means you’ll help our clients evolve and adapt to the rapidly changing healthcare environment and optimize existing business operations, improve clinical outcomes, create a more consumer-centric healthcare experience, and drive physician, patient and employee engagement across the enterprise.

Join our team as the expert you are now and create your future.

Responsibilities

  • Identify, design, and drive intelligent automation solutions to develop and implement strategies for SC cost reduction and efficiency.
  • Leverage automated solutions to optimize the review of purchased services, clinical supplies, and GPO contracts.
  • Collaborate with clinical teams to streamline procurement of clinical supplies and physician preference items using technology.

  • Assist in developing proposals and presentations for potential clients, highlighting technological efficiencies.
  • Build relationships with internal and external stakeholders, focusing on technology-driven initiatives.
  • Communicate progress and outcomes of supply chain improvements to executive leadership.
  • Lead cross-functional teams to achieve organizational goals through innovative solutions.
  • Identify and implement intelligent automation opportunities to streamline internal SC methodologies with a focus on improving quality and reducing the cost to deliver.
  • Identify third party solutions and relationships to accelerate SC intelligent automation through partnerships and potential acquisitions.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred.
  • Minimum of 7-10 years of experience in healthcare supply chain management and consulting.
  • Proven track record of designing SC intelligent automation solutions to achieve cost reductions and process improvements.
  • Strong knowledge of GPOs, clinical supplies, physician preference items, and purchased / support services.
  • Experience with current and evolving inventory management systems and automation technologies within the Healthcare and Supply Chain industries.
  • Experience with developing automated or AI solutions to meet internal or client needs, Data Science or Engineering experience preferred.
  • Experience with Large Language Models and their use in the healthcare industry.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Compensation

The estimated base salary range for this job is $215,000 - $265,000. The range represents a good faith estimate of the range that Huron reasonably expects to pay for this job at the time of the job posting. The actual salary paid to an individual will vary based on multiple factors, including but not limited to specific skills or certifications, years of experience, market changes, and required travel. This job is also eligible to participate in Huron’s annual incentive compensation program, which reflects Huron’s pay for performance philosophy. Inclusive of annual incentive compensation opportunity, the total estimated compensation range for this job is $268,750 - $350,750. The job is also eligible to participate in Huron’s benefit plans which include medical, dental and vision coverage and other wellness programs. The salary range information provided is in accordance with applicable state and local laws regarding salary transparency that are currently in effect and may be implemented in the future.

title: Medical Director
description:
Overview

You could be the one who changes everything for our 28 million members as a clinical professional on our Medical Management/Health Services team. Centene is a diversified, national organization offering competitive benefits including a fresh perspective on workplace flexibility.

We\'re Hiring: Full-time Medical Directors

Centene Corporation is a leading provider of government-sponsored healthcare coverage, providing access to affordable, high-quality services to Medicaid and Medicare members, as well as to individuals and families served by the Health Insurance Marketplace.

Looking for a compelling opportunity to move beyond patient encounters and drive meaningful change in the community?

Qualifications

  • MD or DO without restrictions
  • Must be licensed in New York
  • Board certified in Internal Medicine or Family Medicine
  • Utilization Management experience and knowledge of quality accreditation standards.
  • Actively practices medicine

Position Purpose

Assist the Chief Medical Director to direct and coordinate the medical management, quality improvement and credentialing functions for the business unit.

Responsibilities

  • Provides medical leadership of all for utilization management, cost containment, and medical quality improvement activities.
  • Performs medical review activities pertaining to utilization review, quality assurance, and medical review of complex, controversial, or experimental medical services, ensuring timely and quality decision making.
  • Supports effective implementation of performance improvement initiatives for capitated providers.
  • Assists Chief Medical Director in planning and establishing goals and policies to improve quality and cost-effectiveness of care and service for members.
  • Provides medical expertise in the operation of approved quality improvement and utilization management programs in accordance with regulatory, state, corporate, and accreditation requirements.
  • Assists the Chief Medical Director in the functioning of the physician committees including committee structure, processes, and membership.
  • Conduct regular rounds to assess and coordinate care for high-risk patients, collaborating with care management teams to optimize outcomes.
  • Collaborates effectively with clinical teams, network providers, appeals team, medical and pharmacy consultants for reviewing complex cases and medical necessity appeals.
  • Participates in provider network development and new market expansion as appropriate.
  • Assists in the development and implementation of physician education with respect to clinical issues and policies.
  • Identifies utilization review studies and evaluates adverse trends in utilization of medical services, unusual provider practice patterns, and adequacy of benefit/payment components.
  • Identifies clinical quality improvement studies to assist in reducing unwarranted variation in clinical practice in order to improve the quality and cost of care.
  • Interfaces with physicians and other providers in order to facilitate implementation of recommendations to providers that would improve utilization and health care quality.
  • Reviews claims involving complex, controversial, or unusual or new services in order to determine medical necessity and appropriate payment.
  • Develops alliances with the provider community through the development and implementation of the medical management programs.
  • As needed, may represent the business unit before various publics both locally and nationally on medical philosophy, policies, and related issues.
  • Represents the business unit at appropriate state committees and other ad hoc committees.
  • May be required to work weekends and holidays in support of business operations, as needed.
  • Consults on MCO clinical policy related to Substance Use Disorders and the cases of individual members for the MCM program on a routine basis.
  • Performs other duties as assigned
  • Complies with all policies and standards

Education/Experience

Medical Doctor or Doctor of Osteopathy. Utilization Management experience and knowledge of quality accreditation standards preferred. Actively practices medicine. Course work in the areas of Health Administration, Health Financing, Insurance, and/or Personnel Management is advantageous. Experience treating or managing care for a culturally diverse population preferred.

License/Certifications

Board certification in a medical specialty recognized by the American Board of Medical Specialists or the American Osteopathic Association\u2019s Department of Certifying Board Services. (Certification in Psychiatry specialty Is required.) Current state license as a MD or DO without restrictions, limitations, or sanctions from government programs.

Pay Range: $231,900.00 - $440,500.00 per year

Centene offers a comprehensive benefits package including: competitive pay, health insurance, 401K and stock purchase plans, tuition reimbursement, paid time off plus holidays, and a flexible approach to work with remote, hybrid, field or office work schedules. Actual pay will be adjusted based on an individual\'s skills, experience, education, and other job-related factors permitted by law , including full-time or part-time status. Total compensation may also include additional forms of incentives. Benefits may be subject to program eligibility.

Centene is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity, and values the ways in which we are different. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Strategic Partnership & Alliance
description:
About RateGain

RateGain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered SaaS solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. RateGain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.

Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today RateGain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.

Exploring the role

RateGain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, RateGain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.

The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.

This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.

How your day will look like / Job responsibility

  • Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
  • Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with RateGain’s GTM strategy in LATAM
  • Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
  • Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
  • Represent RateGain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
  • Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
  • Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trends

Education & Work Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnerships

Knowledge

  • In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem
  • Knowledge of SaaS business models and partnership structures
  • Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectors

Skills

  • Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
  • Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills in Spanish, Portuguese, and English
  • Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
  • Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
  • Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)

Attitude

  • Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
  • Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team
  • High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership
  • Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

title: Healthcare Consulting Manager
description:
Overview

Huron helps its clients drive growth, enhance performance and sustain leadership in the markets they serve. We help healthcare organizations build innovation capabilities and accelerate key growth initiatives, enabling organizations to own the future, instead of being disrupted by it. Together, we empower clients to create sustainable growth, optimize internal processes and deliver better consumer outcomes.

Health systems, hospitals and medical clinics are under immense pressure to improve clinical outcomes and reduce the cost of providing patient care. Investing in new partnerships, clinical services and technology is not enough to create meaningful and substantive change. To succeed long-term, healthcare organizations must empower leaders, clinicians, employees, affiliates and communities to build cultures that foster innovation to achieve the best outcomes for patients.

Joining the Huron team means you’ll help our clients evolve and adapt to the rapidly changing healthcare environment and optimize existing business operations, improve clinical outcomes, create a more consumer-centric healthcare experience, and drive physician, patient and employee engagement across the enterprise.

Join our team as the expert you are now and create your future.

Role overview

Managers play a vibrant, integral role at Huron. Their invaluable knowledge reflects in the projects they manage, and the teams they lead. As change leaders, our Managers build long-standing partnerships with clients, while collaborating with colleagues to solve our clients’ most pressing business challenges. Huron Managers shape and deliver results that seamlessly align with client goals, visions and missions. Remarkably versatile, our Managers also spend significant time mentoring junior staff on the engagement team—where they share expertise as well as feedback and encouragement. This benefits Huron profoundly as it promotes a culture of respect, unity, collaboration, and personal achievement.

As a Manager, you will have the unique ability to specialize in certain areas that showcase and employ your areas of expertise while gaining exposure to a breadth of capabilities across our performance improvement practice. Huron is big enough to offer the opportunity and exposure you need for your career growth—but small enough to give you individual attention needed for professional development. Every colleague contributes to who we are as an organization—and the more you evolve, the more we do. Create your future at Huron.

Required Skills

  • Effective and efficient organization and planning skills with the proven ability to manage complex multi-workstream performance improvement projects or multiple concurrent client engagements, while delegating and overseeing the work of junior team members
  • Proven analytical and critical thinking skills required to synthesize complex data sets and interpret qualitative and quantitative data and trends to implement recommendations resulting in measurable performance improvement and successful organizational change
  • Impactful and professional written and verbal communication skills; ability to set clear project team direction, develop key deliverables, escalate risks, and influence key stakeholders inclusive of client and internal senior leadership
  • Ability to collaborate with team members and client counterparts to understand business challenges, adapt implementation methodologies and approaches to ensure results align with client’s business objectives
  • Team leadership experience including building talent, training, supervising, coaching/mentoring, and providing feedback through performance management
  • Employees are required to follow utilization set by practice and expectations and it is the employees\' responsibility to manage this.
  • Required to complete all assigned instructed courses and compliance trainings

Core Qualifications

  • Bachelor\'s degree required
  • 6+ years of experience (including 2+ years in consulting with external clients)
  • Passion for healthcare and cross-capability projects
  • Proven track record in project management - Demonstrated experience in leading teams, managing timelines, and ensuring quality deliverables
  • The ability to travel based on client, enterprise, or project needs is an essential function of this role. While travel requirements may vary based on business need, the current average travel in the Healthcare practice is less than 50%, annually
  • Exceptional leadership and management skills aligned with our core values
  • Excellent communication skills, both oral and written
  • Ability to quickly establish trust and collaboration with clients and colleagues
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel)
  • Experience in a matrixed organization
  • US Work Authorization required

Additional Job Description

The estimated base salary range for this job is $140,000 - $170,000. The range represents a good faith estimate of the range that Huron reasonably expects to pay for this job at the time of the job posting. The actual salary paid to an individual will vary based on multiple factors, including but not limited to specific skills or certifications, years of experience, market changes, and required travel. This job is also eligible to participate in Huron’s annual incentive compensation program, which reflects Huron’s pay for performance philosophy. Inclusive of annual incentive compensation opportunity, the total estimated compensation range for this job is $161,000 - $212,500. The job is also eligible to participate in Huron’s benefit plans which include medical, dental and vision coverage and other wellness programs. The salary range information provided is in accordance with applicable state and local laws regarding salary transparency that are currently in effect and may be implemented in the future.

title: Senior Azure Cloud Solution Architect
description:
Senior Azure Cloud Solution Architect

Location: Brazil / Argentina (Remote)

Long term contract

Overview

Job Summary

We are seeking a visionary Automation Senior Cloud Solution Architect to lead the technical design and implementation of this transformative capability. This role is pivotal in architecting a scalable, AI-driven solution that seamlessly integrates advanced data processing, intuitive web interfaces, and intelligent automation.

This position demands a strategic leader who thrives in complexity and is deeply committed to cultivating strong stakeholder relationships. You will play a key role in fostering a culture of innovation and collaboration, guiding cross-functional teams to deliver solutions that drive pricing transparency, operational efficiency, and market competitiveness.

The ideal candidate will bring a unique blend of technical depth and strategic foresight, with a proven track record of leveraging cutting-edge technologies to deliver end-to-end automation at scale. The role will interface with Enterprise Architecture, Business leaders, Senior Leaders and Cyber / Privacy / Legal teams.

Responsibilities

  • Champion Software Excellence & Talent Development. Promote strong SDLC practices including clean architecture, automated testing, and scalable design. Mentor junior developers through code reviews, technical guidance, and collaborative learning to foster a high-performing engineering culture.
  • Lead Automation use cases architecture using technologies like GenAI, API, D&A, etc, working closely with Product Managers, automation engineers and stakeholders across business and DTS, and Enterprise Architecture.
  • End-to-End Platform Development. Build and maintain front-end (React, TypeScript, Next.js) and back-end (Python, FastAPI, Node.js) layers that support GenAI workflows and agentic interactions.
  • API & Agent Framework Integration. Design robust REST and GraphQL APIs for real-time agent communication, tool execution, and memory handling. Integrate frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, and vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma, Weaviate).
  • ETL & Data Pipeline Architecture. Architect and optimize ETL pipelines for real-time and batch data processing. Ensure seamless data flow between GenAI services, databases, and user interfaces.
  • Cloud-Native Deployment & Monitoring. Deploy and scale services using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI / CD pipelines. Apply MLOps best practices for monitoring, versioning, and performance tuning of AI components.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration. Work closely with AI researchers, product managers, and delivery teams to align technical execution with strategic goals. Participate in multi-agent orchestration experiments and rapid prototyping cycles.

Key Qualifications and Experiences

Technical Expertise :

  • Cloud Platform Proficiency: Solid experience (minimum 5 years) in architecting, deploying, and managing applications across leading cloud platforms, demonstrating comprehensive knowledge of cloud services including computing, database management, application development, and integration services. Familiarity with cloud-native services (Azure), containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes), and serverless architectures is highly valued.
  • Embedded Systems and CI / CD: Experience with embedded devices, operating systems, and server-client architecture. Proficient in CI / CD and DevSecOps practices.
  • Architecture Design: Experience in Microservices and Event-Driven Architecture. Understanding architecture design principles and patterns. Experience with SQL Server, Web Services (SOAP / REST) and API development.
  • .NET Development Skills: Extensive hands-on experience in building scalable, high-performance applications using .NET technologies, with strong capabilities in C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET, and Entity Framework. Knowledge of web technologies and frameworks, such as Blazor or ASP.NET MVC, is also crucial.
  • Integration with SAP and Salesforce: Demonstrated ability to integrate .NET applications with both SAP and Salesforce platforms, employing APIs and middleware solutions like SAP Process Orchestration or API to facilitate robust data exchange and streamline workflows across these systems.
  • Security and Compliance: Deep understanding of security practices related to cloud-hosted applications, including implementing secure authentication and authorization mechanisms (e.g., OAuth, OpenID Connect) and ensuring compliance with relevant industry security standards.
  • Scalability and High Availability: Proven expertise in designing applications that are highly scalable and resilient, leveraging cloud scalability features such as load balancing, auto-scaling, and caching services to ensure optimal performance and availability.
  • Agile Development Practices: Strong background in Agile methodologies, adept at managing product backlogs, user stories, sprint planning, and releases, particularly within a cloud-hosted application development environment.
  • Strategic Problem Solving and Analytical Thinking: Ability to address complex technical and integration challenges with a strategic mindset, utilizing analytical and data-driven decision-making to optimize the application's performance and capabilities.

Specialized Skills

  • Prototyping: Ability to engage in rapid prototype development using iterative techniques.
  • Vendor and Partner Engagement: Direct experience managing relationships with outsourcing and consulting partners.
  • Cloud Architecture Design: Deep understanding of cloud solutions and architectures, enabling scalable, flexible, and resilient digital infrastructures that support rapid innovation and development.

Soft Skills and Others

  • Agile Collaboration: Demonstrated experience in effectively working with Agile and Product teams, including involvement with epics, user stories, sprints, and backlog management. The ability to collaborate closely with product owners, engineers, and scrum master’s to foster a productive and agile environment.
  • Leadership in Communication and Reporting: Skilled in leading communication efforts and reporting, adept at preparing and presenting comprehensive updates and reports to senior leaders and stakeholders. Ability to succinctly highlight key metrics, progress, and insights, ensuring transparency and alignment at all levels of the organization.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Background in coordinating hardware & software development teams and business owners, with the ability to influence SMEs directly.

title: Strategic Partnership & Alliance
description:
About RateGain

RateGain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered SaaS solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. RateGain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.

Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today RateGain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.

Exploring the role

RateGain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, RateGain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.

description:
Sobre a vaga

Sobre a vaga

Procuramos um(a) Diretor de Operações para estruturar e conduzir o “sistema operacional” da empresa, transformar estratégia em execução, eliminar falhas de follow-up entre solicitações e entregas e garantir cadência, métricas e accountability em todas as áreas.

O(a) Diretor participará das dailys com os gestores de cada área, atuará como elo de comunicação entre times e stakeholders e apresentará mensalmente (em inglês) relatórios executivos consolidados.

Destaques : direito a assistente executivo(a) dedicado(a) e bônus por performance.

Responsabilidades

  • Gestão das operações diárias, garantindo eficiência e alinhamento com a estratégia definida pelo CEO e pelo Conselho.
  • Implementar a visão estratégica em planos de execução operacional com donos, prazos e critérios claros.
  • Supervisionar áreas-chave: desenvolvimento web, desenvolvimento de software, marketing, customer success e suporte.
  • Participar das dailys com os gestores; registrar decisões, prazos, riscos e encaminhamentos.
  • Relatórios operacionais:
  • Diários (EOD): status por área, concluídos do dia, tarefa atual + ETA, próximas 3 tarefas (início / fim), gargalos.
  • Semanais e mensais: consolidação de KPIs, riscos, decisões e plano de ação.
  • Mensais em inglês: apresentações executivas a stakeholders com dados consolidados de todos os setores.
  • Apoiar o CFO com dados operacionais para relatórios financeiros e previsões.
  • Reuniões em inglês para contratação de serviços / fornecedores; reuniões com parceiros B2B para coletar feedback e operacionalizar demandas.
  • Gestão de contratações de colaboradores (pipeline, aprovação, integração) e gestão de desempenho (elevar produtividade; desligar quem não performa).
  • Aprimorar processos visando redução de custos, aumento de produtividade e padronização.
  • Gerenciar KPIs (On-time Delivery, Lead Time, Throughput, WIP, Blocker Aging, SLA stage / prod, MTTR, CSAT / NPS), propor ajustes e remover bloqueios.
  • Conformidade e qualidade nos processos; gestão de riscos e planos de contingência.
  • Fomentar inovação em processos, sistemas e práticas de gestão.
  • Assegurar comunicação clara entre áreas e níveis da empresa.
  • Disciplina de ferramentas: Jira (backlog, prazos, status, dashboards) e Confluence (documentação, atas, decisões) como fontes únicas de verdade.

Requisitos

  • 3+ anos como Diretor de Operações (ou função executiva equivalente).
  • 5+ anos de experiência comprovada em tecnologia e experiência prévia em empresa de software.
  • Conhecimento sólido sobre jogos online (conceitos de latência / lag, jitter, perda de pacotes, impacto na operação e suporte).
  • Domínio prático de Jira e Confluence.
  • Inglês fluente (falado e escrito): dailys, relatórios e apresentações mensais a stakeholders; calls com fornecedores e parceiros.
  • Liderança hands-on, orientação a dados, habilidade de priorizar, cobrar resultados e resolver bloqueios rapidamente.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência profissional no mercado de games.
  • Conhecimento de frameworks de gestão (OKRs, RACI, SLAs).
  • Certificações relevantes (Lean / Six Sigma, PMP, Agile / SAFe).

Sucesso nos 90 dias

  • Dailys com gestores estabelecidas e atas no Confluence.
  • Relatórios diários, semanais e mensais publicados com consistência.
  • Apresentações mensais em inglês bem-sucedidas com os stakeholders, com dados consolidados de todos os setores, decisões registradas no Confluence e plano de ação com owners e ETAs.
  • Dashboard no Jira confiável (prazos, status stage / prod, SLAs).
  • Redução visível de atrasos, itens sem dono e falhas de follow-up.

Ambiente & benefícios

  • Trabalho 100% remoto, autonomia e alto impacto.
  • Assistente executivo(a) dedicado(a).
  • Remuneração compatível com mercado + bônus por performance.
  • Cultura de disciplina, colaboração e melhoria contínua.

title: SDR II (Escolas)
description:
O isaac é a maior plataforma de soluções financeiras feita para escolas. Impulsionamos as instituições oferecendo receita garantida e proporcionando mais flexibilidade de pagamento para as famílias.

Nosso objetivo é facilitar a gestão financeira, acabando com a dor de cabeça e permitindo que a escola consiga focar na missão de educar , dedicando mais tempo e recursos para tirar os planos do papel.

Nos últimos 4 anos, já ajudamos mais de 2.000 escolas, garantimos mais de R$5bi em mensalidades garantidas, e ajudamos a aumentar em 9% o número de matrículas em nossas escolas parceiras.

A cultura do isaac incentiva a autonomia, a mão na massa, o trabalho em equipe e o uso de dados para construir soluções inovadoras.

Temos muito para construir e transformar na Educação brasileira, e você pode fazer parte dessa revolução, vivenciando o impacto do seu trabalho na sociedade!

Vem com a gente?

No isaac acreditamos em uma venda personalizada e consultiva. Gostamos de nos conectar com o cliente de forma responsável, empática e transparente, criando relações reais e duradouras. Enxergamos a venda como o primeiro passo para transformar a gestão escolar em algo simples e eficiente.

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa para integrar nosso time de SDR e ajudar a abrir portas para o isaac no mercado de educação (escolas privadas). Procuramos alguém orientado a resultados, colaborativo e comunicativo, que se sinta confortável em interagir com diferentes perfis de pessoas em múltiplos canais.

No dia a dia você irá:

  • Agendar reuniões com personas definidas, seguindo SLAs pré-estabelecidos;
  • Manter atualizadas as atividades de prospecção no CRM;
  • Desenvolver e aprimorar cadências de prospecção, analisando métricas e buscando melhorias de conversão;
  • Qualificar e enriquecer listas de leads, garantindo informações relevantes;
  • Garantir contato rápido com clientes potenciais;
  • Atuar sempre com orientação a resultados e metas;
  • Demonstrar resiliência e adaptabilidade frente a mudanças de objetivos e estratégias;
  • Colaborar com outras áreas internas, compartilhando aprendizados e insights sobre os clientes.

Para participar do nosso processo você precisa ter:

  • Ensino superior completo ou em andamento;
  • Experiência em prospecção outbound e inbound;
  • Conhecimento em modelos de vendas consultivas (SPIN, BANT, GPCT ou similares);
  • Excelente comunicação oral e escrita, com habilidade para textos claros e concisos;
  • Facilidade para trabalhar em equipe;
  • Perfil orientado a resultados, proativo e com vontade de aprender.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência prévia com vendas B2B;
  • Auxílio alimentação e/ou refeição (Flash Benefícios - R$40,50/dia);
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico Sulamérica sem mensalidade e com coparticipação;
  • Licença maternidade (180 dias) e paternidade (30 dias) estendida;
  • Auxílio creche para mamães e papais com filhos até 06 anos;
  • Cuidado com a saúde física para você e seus dependentes: parceria com a Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Incentivo à educação - parcerias com diversas instituições de ensino;
  • ArcoLab - plataforma de educação corporativa;
  • Desconto em passagens aéreas e hospedagens;
  • Férias flexíveis (antecipação de 15 dias de férias após 6 meses).

#MaisDiversidade

Acreditamos que em um ambiente diverso e inclusivo nossas pessoas serão mais felizes, engajadas e com mais chances de atingir o seu máximo potencial . Por isso, aqui no isaac - uma empresa do Grupo Arco Educação, respeitamos e valorizamos a igualdade de direito, reconhecemos as singularidades e acreditamos que todas as pessoas podem contribuir para o nosso propósito. #vemproisaac

title: Senior Product Manager | Vaga exclusiva para PCD | Always Hiring
description:
Sobre o Jusbrasil

Somos uma empresa de tecnologia, cujo propósito é proporcionar e viabilizar uma Justiça melhor e gerar mais confiança nas relações sociais através do acesso à informação. Estamos caminhando para sermos reconhecidos como single source of truth para informações jurídicas e construir esse caminho não é trivial. Lidamos diariamente com problemas complexos que exigem pensamento crítico e analítico para propor soluções que nunca foram pensadas. Hoje estamos na casa das centenas de colaboradores espalhados em mais de 40 cidades no Brasil e fora. E a nossa sustentabilidade como empresa vai ser diretamente proporcional ao aumento da nossa densidade e diversidade de talentos com o crescimento desse time incrível que já temos.

Jusbrasil em números:

  • + de 1,2 bi de documentos jurídicos de interesse público
  • + de 1PB de dados na nossa infraestrutura de tecnologia
  • + de 30 m de usuários
  • + de 700 colaboradores
  • + de 80% dos advogados brasileiros cadastrados

Sobre a função

Como Product Manager no Jus, você será responsável por definições táticas e estratégicas das frentes de trabalho e produtos para alavancar os resultados da empresa. Enxergamos a pessoa PM no Jus como alguém mão-na-massa, cuja função é orquestrar e direcionar as equipes rumo à visão da empresa, além de delinear a visão dos produtos nos quais trabalha. Para fazer isso, precisará definir a priorização do produto, justificando suas posições e apostas com base em análises e pesquisas quantitativas e qualitativas. Além disso, a pessoa Product Manager é quem conecta e equilibra os resultados do negócio ao usuário, responsável por dar visibilidade do estado da empresa aos stakeholders internos e externos, via métricas, KPIs e OKRs.

Trabalhando em conjunto com times que utilizam tecnologia de ponta em Machine Learning, Information Retrieval e NPL, você trabalhará lado-a-lado de engenheiros, designers, analistas de dados, outros PMs e stakeholders em toda a empresa.

  • Conforto para desempenhar e facilitar análises de dados;
  • Capacidade de delinear a visão de negócio e ajudar nossa equipe de desenvolvedores a transformá-la em código;
  • Proficiência em gestão de equipes de produto multidisciplinares;
  • Comunicação verbal e não-verbal precisa para fazer interlocução com múltiplos stakeholders;
  • Experiência comprovada como Product Manager ou função semelhante;
  • Experiência comprovada com produtos de interface com o usuário.

Será um diferencial se

  • Já ter exercido funções como pessoa desenvolvedora, analista de dados ou marketing digital;
  • Experiência prévia com projetos de múltiplas dependências e/ou stakeholders.

Informações Importantes

“Esta é uma vaga afirmativa para pessoas com deficiência (PCDs). Acreditamos que times diversos são mais fortes, criativos e representativos da sociedade. Por isso, buscamos intencionalmente atrair e incluir profissionais com deficiência em nosso time, promovendo um ambiente acessível, respeitoso e com oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento.

Caso você participe de um processo seletivo afirmativo para Pessoa com Deficiência no Jusbrasil, nossa equipe de Talent Acquisition solicitará a apresentação do seu laudo médico ou do Certificado de Reabilitação Profissional emitido pelo INSS. O documento deve estar assinado e validado por profissional com CRM, e será analisado conforme os critérios estabelecidos nos artigos 89 e 90 da Instrução Normativa MTP nº 2, de 08/11/2021.

Ao fornecer essas informações, você declara que elas são verdadeiras e compreende que, em casos de incompatibilidade entre o laudo apresentado e os requisitos legais da vaga afirmativa, isso poderá ser considerado no processo de avaliação e eventual não preenchimento da posição.

Esta é uma vaga para o nosso banco de talentos, que está sempre aberto para conhecer novas pessoas. Por ser uma vaga de cadastro, não temos previsão para retorno imediato, mas manteremos seu perfil em nosso radar para futuras oportunidades.

Nível: Executivo

Responsabilidades

  • Gestão das operações diárias, garantindo eficiência e alinhamento com a estratégia definida pelo CEO e pelo Conselho.

  • Domínio prático de Jira e Confluence.
  • Inglês fluente (falado e escrito): dailys, relatórios e apresentações mensais a stakeholders; calls com fornecedores e parceiros.

Diferenciais

Ambiente & benefícios

  • Trabalho 100% remoto, autonomia e alto impacto.

  • Cultura de disciplina, colaboração e melhoria contínua.

title: Strategic Partnership & Alliance
description:
Overview

About RateGain

RateGain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered SaaS solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. RateGain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.

Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today RateGain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.

Exploring the role

RateGain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, RateGain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.

The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.

This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.

Responsibilities

  • Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
  • Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with RateGain’s GTM strategy in LATAM
  • Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
  • Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
  • Represent RateGain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
  • Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
  • Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trends

Education & Work Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnerships

Knowledge

  • In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem
  • Knowledge of SaaS business models and partnership structures
  • Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectors

Skills

  • Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
  • Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills in Spanish, Portuguese, and English
  • Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
  • Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
  • Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)

Attitude

  • Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
  • Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team
  • High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership
  • Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment

description:
Overview

Senior Azure Cloud Solution Architect

Location: Brazil / Argentina (Remote)

Long term contract

Job Summary: We are seeking a visionary Automation Senior Cloud Solution Architect to lead the technical design and implementation of this transformative capability. This role is pivotal in architecting a scalable, AI-driven solution that seamlessly integrates advanced data processing, intuitive web interfaces, and intelligent automation.

This position demands a strategic leader who thrives in complexity and is deeply committed to cultivating strong stakeholder relationships. You will play a key role in fostering a culture of innovation and collaboration, guiding cross-functional teams to deliver solutions that drive pricing transparency, operational efficiency, and market competitiveness.

The ideal candidate will bring a unique blend of technical depth and strategic foresight, with a proven track record of leveraging cutting-edge technologies to deliver end-to-end automation at scale. The role will interface with Enterprise Architecture, Business leaders, Senior Leaders and Cyber / Privacy / Legal teams.

Responsibilities

  • Champion Software Excellence & Talent Development. Promote strong SDLC practices including clean architecture, automated testing, and scalable design. Mentor junior developers through code reviews, technical guidance, and collaborative learning to foster a high-performing engineering culture.
  • Lead Automation use cases architecture using technologies like GenAI, API, D&A, etc, working closely with Product Managers, automation engineers and stakeholders across business and DTS, and Enterprise Architecture.
  • End-to-End Platform Development. Build and maintain front-end (React, TypeScript, Next.js) and back-end (Python, FastAPI, Node.js) layers that support GenAI workflows and agentic interactions.
  • API & Agent Framework Integration. Design robust REST and GraphQL APIs for real-time agent communication, tool execution, and memory handling. Integrate frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, and vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma, Weaviate).
  • ETL & Data Pipeline Architecture. Architect and optimize ETL pipelines for real-time and batch data processing. Ensure seamless data flow between GenAI services, databases, and user interfaces.
  • Cloud-Native Deployment & Monitoring. Deploy and scale services using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI / CD pipelines. Apply MLOps best practices for monitoring, versioning, and performance tuning of AI components.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration. Work closely with AI researchers, product managers, and delivery teams to align technical execution with strategic goals. Participate in multi-agent orchestration experiments and rapid prototyping cycles.

Qualifications

Technical Expertise :

  • Cloud Platform Proficiency: Solid experience (minimum 5 years) in architecting, deploying, and managing applications across leading cloud platforms, demonstrating comprehensive knowledge of cloud services including computing, database management, application development, and integration services. Familiarity with cloud-native services (Azure), containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes), and serverless architectures is highly valued.
  • Embedded Systems and CI / CD: Experience with embedded devices, operating systems, and server-client architecture. Proficient in CI / CD and DevSecOps practices.
  • Architecture Design: Experience in Microservices and Event-Driven Architecture. Understanding architecture design principles and patterns. Experience with SQL Server, Web Services (SOAP / REST) and API development.
  • .NET Development Skills: Extensive hands-on experience in building scalable, high-performance applications using .NET technologies, with strong capabilities in C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET, and Entity Framework. Knowledge of web technologies and frameworks, such as Blazor or ASP.NET MVC, is also crucial.
  • Integration with SAP and Salesforce: Demonstrated ability to integrate .NET applications with both SAP and Salesforce platforms, employing APIs and middleware solutions like SAP Process Orchestration or API to facilitate robust data exchange and streamline workflows across these systems.
  • Security and Compliance: Deep understanding of security practices related to cloud-hosted applications, including implementing secure authentication and authorization mechanisms (e.g., OAuth, OpenID Connect) and ensuring compliance with relevant industry security standards.
  • Scalability and High Availability: Proven expertise in designing applications that are highly scalable and resilient, leveraging cloud scalability features such as load balancing, auto-scaling, and caching services to ensure optimal performance and availability.
  • Agile Development Practices: Strong background in Agile methodologies, adept at managing product backlogs, user stories, sprint planning, and releases, particularly within a cloud-hosted application development environment.
  • Strategic Problem Solving and Analytical Thinking: Ability to address complex technical and integration challenges with a strategic mindset, utilizing analytical and data-driven decision-making to optimize the application's performance and capabilities.

Specialized Skills :

  • Prototyping: Ability to engage in rapid prototype development using iterative techniques.
  • Vendor and Partner Engagement: Direct experience managing relationships with outsourcing and consulting partners.
  • Cloud Architecture Design: Deep understanding of cloud solutions and architectures, enabling scalable, flexible, and resilient digital infrastructures that support rapid innovation and development.

Soft Skills and Others :

  • Agile Collaboration: Demonstrated experience in effectively working with Agile and Product teams, including involvement with epics, user stories, sprints, and backlog management. The ability to collaborate closely with product owners, engineers, and scrum master’s to foster a productive and agile environment.
  • Leadership in Communication and Reporting: Skilled in leading communication efforts and reporting, adept at preparing and presenting comprehensive updates and reports to senior leaders and stakeholders. Ability to succinctly highlight key metrics, progress, and insights, ensuring transparency and alignment at all levels of the organization.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Background in coordinating hardware & software development teams and business owners, with the ability to influence SMEs directly.

title: Consulting Senior Director - Supply Chain Automation
description:
Overview

Huron helps its clients drive growth, enhance performance and sustain leadership in the markets they serve. We help healthcare organizations build innovation capabilities and accelerate key growth initiatives, enabling organizations to own the future, instead of being disrupted by it. Together, we empower clients to create sustainable growth, optimize internal processes and deliver better consumer outcomes. Health systems, hospitals and medical clinics are under pressure to improve clinical outcomes and reduce the cost of providing patient care. Investing in partnerships, clinical services and technology is not enough to create meaningful change. To succeed long-term, healthcare organizations must empower leaders, clinicians, employees, affiliates and communities to build cultures that foster innovation to achieve the best outcomes for patients. Joining the Huron team means you’ll help our clients evolve and adapt to the rapidly changing healthcare environment and optimize existing business operations, improve clinical outcomes, create a more consumer-centric healthcare experience, and drive physician, patient and employee engagement across the enterprise. Join our team as the expert you are now and create your future.

Responsibilities

  • Identify, design, and drive intelligent automation solutions to develop and implement strategies for supply chain cost reduction and efficiency.
  • Leverage automated solutions to optimize the review of purchased services, clinical supplies, and GPO contracts.
  • Collaborate with clinical teams to streamline procurement of clinical supplies and physician preference items using technology.
  • Participate in the development and implementation of intelligent automation tools to drive best practices in inventory management.
  • Assist in developing proposals and presentations for potential clients, highlighting technological efficiencies.
  • Build relationships with internal and external stakeholders, focusing on technology-driven initiatives.
  • Communicate progress and outcomes of supply chain improvements to executive leadership.
  • Lead cross-functional teams to achieve organizational goals through innovative solutions.
  • Identify and implement intelligent automation opportunities to streamline internal supply chain methodologies with a focus on improving quality and reducing the cost to deliver.
  • Identify third-party solutions and relationships to accelerate supply chain intelligent automation through partnerships and potential acquisitions.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor\'s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred.
  • Minimum of 7-10 years of experience in healthcare supply chain management and consulting.
  • Proven track record of designing supply chain intelligent automation solutions to achieve cost reductions and process improvements.
  • Strong knowledge of GPOs, clinical supplies, physician preference items, and purchased/support services.
  • Experience with current and evolving inventory management systems and automation technologies within the healthcare and supply chain industries.
  • Experience with developing automated or AI solutions to meet internal or client needs; Data Science or Engineering experience preferred.
  • Experience with Large Language Models and their use in the healthcare industry.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Compensation

The estimated base salary range for this job is $215,000 - $265,000. The range represents a good faith estimate of the range that Huron reasonably expects to pay for this job at the time of the job posting. The actual salary paid to an individual will vary based on multiple factors, including but not limited to specific skills or certifications, years of experience, market changes, and required travel. This job is also eligible to participate in Huron’s annual incentive compensation program, which reflects Huron’s pay-for-performance philosophy. Inclusive of annual incentive compensation opportunity, the total estimated compensation range for this job is $268,750 - $350,750. The job is also eligible to participate in Huron’s benefit plans which include medical, dental and vision coverage and other wellness programs. The salary range information provided is in accordance with applicable state and local laws regarding salary transparency that are currently in effect and may be implemented in the future.

São mais de 180 clínicas em todo o país, mais de 1 milhão de sorrisos cuidados com carinho e cerca de 9 mil atendimentos realizados por dia. Tudo isso só é possível porque temos um time incrível por trás de cada resultado.

Somos a primeira rede de franquias odontológicas do país e, ao longo dos anos, colecionamos conquistas como o Troféu Excelência em Franchising da ABF e o reconhecimento como uma das Melhores Franquias do Brasil pela revista Pequenas Empresas & Grandes Negócios. Acreditamos no poder da educação continuada como alicerce para inovação, performance e encantamento.

Na Odontoclinic, você encontra um ambiente acolhedor, diverso e cheio de oportunidades. Um lugar onde você pode ser quem é, crescer, aprender e deixar sua marca. Se você tem espírito empreendedor, gosta de desafios e quer fazer parte de algo grande, seu lugar é aqui.

title: Senior Azure Cloud Solution Architect
description:
Overview

Senior Azure Cloud Solution Architect

Location: Brazil / Argentina (Remote)

Long term contract

Job Summary

We are seeking a visionary Automation Senior Cloud Solution Architect to lead the technical design and implementation of this transformative capability. This role is pivotal in architecting a scalable, AI-driven solution that seamlessly integrates advanced data processing, intuitive web interfaces, and intelligent automation.

This position demands a strategic leader who thrives in complexity and is deeply committed to cultivating strong stakeholder relationships. You will play a key role in fostering a culture of innovation and collaboration, guiding cross-functional teams to deliver solutions that drive pricing transparency, operational efficiency, and market competitiveness.

The ideal candidate will bring a unique blend of technical depth and strategic foresight, with a proven track record of leveraging cutting-edge technologies to deliver end-to-end automation at scale. The role will interface with Enterprise Architecture, Business leaders, Senior Leaders and Cyber / Privacy / Legal teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Champion Software Excellence & Talent Development. Promote strong SDLC practices including clean architecture, automated testing, and scalable design. Mentor junior developers through code reviews, technical guidance, and collaborative learning to foster a high-performing engineering culture.
  • Lead Automation use cases architecture using technologies like GenAI, API, D&A, etc, working closely with Product Managers, automation engineers and stakeholders across business and DTS, and Enterprise Architecture.
  • End-to-End Platform Development. Build and maintain front-end (React, TypeScript, Next.js) and back-end (Python, FastAPI, Node.js) layers that support GenAI workflows and agentic interactions.
  • API & Agent Framework Integration. Design robust REST and GraphQL APIs for real-time agent communication, tool execution, and memory handling. Integrate frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, and vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma, Weaviate).
  • ETL & Data Pipeline Architecture. Architect and optimize ETL pipelines for real-time and batch data processing. Ensure seamless data flow between GenAI services, databases, and user interfaces.
  • Cloud-Native Deployment & Monitoring. Deploy and scale services using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI / CD pipelines. Apply MLOps best practices for monitoring, versioning, and performance tuning of AI components.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration. Work closely with AI researchers, product managers, and delivery teams to align technical execution with strategic goals. Participate in multi-agent orchestration experiments and rapid prototyping cycles.

Key Qualifications and Experiences

Technical Expertise :

  • Cloud Platform Proficiency: Solid experience (minimum 5 years) in architecting, deploying, and managing applications across leading cloud platforms, demonstrating comprehensive knowledge of cloud services including computing, database management, application development, and integration services. Familiarity with cloud-native services (Azure), containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes), and serverless architectures is highly valued.
  • Embedded Systems and CI / CD: Experience with embedded devices, operating systems, and server-client architecture. Proficient in CI / CD and DevSecOps practices.
  • Architecture Design: Experience in Microservices and Event-Driven Architecture. Understanding architecture design principles and patterns. Experience with SQL Server, Web Services (SOAP / REST) and API development.
  • .NET Development Skills: Extensive hands-on experience in building scalable, high-performance applications using .NET technologies, with strong capabilities in C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET, and Entity Framework. Knowledge of web technologies and frameworks, such as Blazor or ASP.NET MVC, is also crucial.
  • Integration with SAP and Salesforce: Demonstrated ability to integrate .NET applications with both SAP and Salesforce platforms, employing APIs and middleware solutions like SAP Process Orchestration or API to facilitate robust data exchange and streamline workflows across these systems.
  • Security and Compliance: Deep understanding of security practices related to cloud-hosted applications, including implementing secure authentication and authorization mechanisms (e.g., OAuth, OpenID Connect) and ensuring compliance with relevant industry security standards.
  • Scalability and High Availability: Proven expertise in designing applications that are highly scalable and resilient, leveraging cloud scalability features such as load balancing, auto-scaling, and caching services to ensure optimal performance and availability.
  • Agile Development Practices: Strong background in Agile methodologies, adept at managing product backlogs, user stories, sprint planning, and releases, particularly within a cloud-hosted application development environment.
  • Strategic Problem Solving and Analytical Thinking: Ability to address complex technical and integration challenges with a strategic mindset, utilizing analytical and data-driven decision-making to optimize the application's performance and capabilities.

Specialized Skills :

  • Prototyping: Ability to engage in rapid prototype development using iterative techniques.
  • Vendor and Partner Engagement: Direct experience managing relationships with outsourcing and consulting partners.
  • Cloud Architecture Design: Deep understanding of cloud solutions and architectures, enabling scalable, flexible, and resilient digital infrastructures that support rapid innovation and development.

Soft Skills and Others :

  • Agile Collaboration: Demonstrated experience in effectively working with Agile and Product teams, including involvement with epics, user stories, sprints, and backlog management. The ability to collaborate closely with product owners, engineers, and scrum master’s to foster a productive and agile environment.
  • Leadership in Communication and Reporting: Skilled in leading communication efforts and reporting, adept at preparing and presenting comprehensive updates and reports to senior leaders and stakeholders. Ability to succinctly highlight key metrics, progress, and insights, ensuring transparency and alignment at all levels of the organization.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Background in coordinating hardware & software development teams and business owners, with the ability to influence SMEs directly.

Estamos em busca de um(a) SDRpara atuar no segmento de faculdades, ajudando a expandir nosso impacto no setor educacional. Essa pessoa fará parte do time comercial, atuando diretamente na qualificação de leads e na abertura de novas oportunidades.

No dia a dia você irá:

  • Realizar contato ativo com leads gerados pelo time de Geração de Demanda, apresentando o isaac de forma consultiva e qualificando potenciais clientes;
  • Prospectar e encantar novas faculdades, demonstrando como o isaac pode simplificar sua gestão financeira e administrativa;
  • Identificar dores e necessidades de CFOs, diretores financeiros e mantenedores de faculdades;
  • Agendar reuniões qualificadas para o time de consultores comerciais, garantindo que cheguem preparadas e com informações relevantes;
  • Manter o CRM atualizado, registrando histórico de interações, garantindo clareza e qualidade de dados;
  • Desenvolver cadências de prospecção e contribuir para melhorar fluxos de contato e conversão;
  • Colaborar de perto com o(a) SDR Sênior, aprendendo com a experiência do time e acelerando resultados;
  • Apoiar na identificação de oportunidades de mercado, trazendo feedbacks para aprimorar nosso produto e abordagem.

  • Experiência prévia como SDR, pré-vendas ou prospecção comercial B2B;

  • Comunicação clara, boa argumentação e desenvoltura para interagir com decisores de alto nível;
  • Organização, atenção aos detalhes e disciplina no uso de CRM;
  • Proatividade para buscar conhecimento e propor melhorias nos processos;
